scientific_integrity: The all-dimensional conclusion is supported by a direct analytic vertex classification, permutation-invariant quadratic-form optimality proof, and a separate exact-rational finite consistency check. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact real Hilbert Banach–Mazur distance only for unit-edge complete bipartite graph metrics with both part sizes at least three; no weighted, complex, or arbitrary bipartite graph generalization; historical equivalence risk remains.
title: Maximal Hilbert distortion for complete-bipartite transportation spaces
